portInfo.description: Ushuaia is the southernmost major cruise and Antarctic gateway in Argentina. National port agency materials cite a 550 m × 28 m multipurpose quay, more than 500 international cruise calls, and roughly 250,000 seasonal visitors. Administrative changes were reported for early 2026 — confirm embarkation details with your cruise line.

gettingThere.walkingTime: 10-15 minutes to city center—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Town / End of the World museum — walkable if weather allows.
Tierra del Fuego NP — half day.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Wind and sudden weather changes can cancel boats — keep a town backup plan.
